# LaoZhang AI Blog

> > Technical blog covering AI API pricing, optimization, and implementation guides for Gemini, Claude, ChatGPT, Sora, and Nano Banana models.

LaoZhang AI Blog provides comprehensive guides on AI model APIs, focusing on cost optimization, error troubleshooting, and practical implementation. The site features detailed comparisons of major AI platforms including Google Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, and emerging image/video generation models.
